recipes.name: Red lentil soup with lemon
recipes.method_note: Squeeze the lemon in at the table. It lifts the whole bowl.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Heat {{ing:olive-oil}} in a large pan on a medium heat.
Fry onion and carrot 8 minutes, until soft.
Stir in garlic, {{ing:cumin-ground}}, {{ing:paprika}} and {{ing:passata}}. Cook 2 minutes.
Rinse {{ing:lentils-red-dry}}. Add with {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer (small bubbles) 25 minutes, until the lentils fall apart.
Blend until smooth.
Serve with wedges of {{ing:lemon}} and a pinch of {{ing:chilli-powder}}.

recipes.name: Poached eggs on garlic yoghurt
recipes.method_note: The yoghurt is served at room temperature, the eggs hot, the butter sizzling.

steps.instruction: Take {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} out of the fridge. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}} into it. Stir.
Spread the yoghurt over two plates.
Bring a pan of water to a gentle simmer (small bubbles).
Crack in {{ing:egg-medium}}. Poach 3 minutes, until the whites are firm.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a small pan with {{ing:paprika}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}.
Lift the eggs onto the yoghurt with a slotted spoon.
Spoon the red butter over. Scatter {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Toast {{ing:bread-slice-medium}} for dipping.

Coconut or soya yoghurt, to make it dairy free

recipes.name: Lamb and aubergine bake with yoghurt
recipes.method_note: Roasting the aubergine first stops it going spongy.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Slice {{ing:aubergine}} into rounds. Brush with {{ing:olive-oil}} on a tray.
Roast 20 minutes, until soft and golden.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Fry {{ing:lamb-mince}} in a pan on a high heat for 8 minutes, until browned.
Add onion, garlic, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:cumin-ground}}. Fry 5 minutes.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}. Simmer 10 minutes, until thick.
Layer the lamb and aubergine in a baking dish.
Beat {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} with {{ing:egg-medium}}. Spread over the top.
Bake 25 minutes, until the top is set and golden.
Scatter chopped {{ing:fresh-mint}} to serve.
